LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the Library
   D. where is the library

2. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)

   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a joining word

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Non- fiction: Introduction - Features of non-fiction - Categories of non-fiction.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Non- fiction: Introduction - Features of non-fiction - Categories of non-fiction.

4. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
